# Aesthetic Nursing Policy & Procedures, Inc.

> Nurse-led med spa compliance consulting, state-specific aesthetic nursing policy and procedure manuals, standardized procedures and continuing education from Cindi Vokey, BSN, RN, LNC (San Diego, CA; serving practices across the United States). CA BRN-Approved CE Provider #18009. Manuals are educational practice resources to be reviewed and approved with the practice's medical director; they are not State Board approved and are not legal advice.

## Services
- [Solutions](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/services/): Practice Review ($950), Manual Set (from $1,950), Practice Review + Manuals + Implementation (from $3,995), Consulting Retainer ($350/month for 12 months), Compliance CE Courses
- [Manual Builder](https://theaestheticmanual.com/): State-specific med spa policy and procedure manual builder (open now; order online at https://theaestheticmanual.com, from $1,950)
- [Practice Manuals](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/practice-manuals/): Customized manuals, not templates
- [Book a Free Consultation](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/book/): Free 30-minute Zoom consult
- [Contact & Booking](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/contact/): Practice compliance quiz, contact details and map

## Free Resources
- [Med Spa Compliance Readiness Checklist](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/compliance-checklist/): 28-checkpoint self-audit
- [The Accusation Review](https://aestheticnursingpnp.com/research/): Findings from 35 aesthetic Board accusations
